title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：rabbit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rabbit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the keeper ① kept the rabbit that no child in the zoo would have counted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the season. The ② rabbit, meaning the animal itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a rabbit, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ rabbit in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ rabbit at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rabbit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the keeper said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rabbit was the whole of the matter, meaning the timidity and not the animal. The ⑥ rabbit, meaning the timidity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; rabbit, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both an animal and a timidity. He said the timidity is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ rabbit had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ rabbit of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of counting; rabbit, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rabbit I remember is the animal counted in the register, which closed in 1973 and is still counted as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ rabbit, my mother said in 1975, is the only animal that improves by being counted; every rabbit, she said, is a timidity that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the timidity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 兔子（指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 兔子（指那只兔子本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the rabbit 养这一只兔子
D. n. 兔子（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 兔子之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的兔子之事）
F. n. 兔子（指饲养台账里写到、被清点的那一只）
G. n. 兔子、胆小（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 胆小（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the rabbit that no child in the zoo would have counted
The rabbit, meaning the animal itself and not the fence
the rabbit at the far shed
the rabbit was the whole of the matter
the rabbit had become a line in a register
The rabbit of the whole thing
A rabbit, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: keep the rabbit 意为“养这一只兔子”，1966 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯清点的一只兔子做了一遍。
rabbit 意为“兔子”，指那只兔子本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被清点。
rabbit 意为“兔子”，指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
rabbit 意为“兔子”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rabbit 意为“兔子、胆小”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只胆小就是那件事的全部。
rabbit 意为“胆小”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只兔子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rabbit 意为“兔子”，指饲养台账里写到、被清点的那一只，到 1971 年这一只成了饲养台账里的一行。
rabbit 意为“兔子之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的兔子之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的清点。
rabbit 意为“兔子”，我记得的是饲养台账里清点过的那一只，1973 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一只。
rabbit 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，兔子是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的兔子。
